title_as_printed: Relative Densities (Delta rho = rho - rho0, g cm-3) of the Mixtures at 25 C and I = 1.5 m
pressure_note: not stated (paper gives no pressure; Picker vibrating-flow densimeter at 25 C)

value.what: rho - rho0, difference from pure water density rho0 (reference: density of pure water at 25 C; paper states Delta rho = rho - rho0)

composition.other_species: none beyond the salts named in the label row: binary or two-salt mixtures of NaCl, KCl, Na2SO4, K2SO4 at total ionic strength I = 1.5 m; salt pair (2)-(3) in the label row; y3 = w3 m3/(w2 m2 + w3 m3) with w = 1 for 1-1 and 3 for 2-1 electrolytes; y3 = 0 is pure salt 2 and y3 = 1.0 is pure salt 3

skip_rows.reason: label rows: salt pair printed in the mixture column (first data row printed beside the label, written as its own label row)

conversion_needs: ionic strength (molality scale) and y3 to molalities of the two salts: m_i = y_i I / w_i style conversion; do not convert here
Delta rho is relative to pure water; absolute density needs rho0(25 C)
notes: Note: pairs include 'pure' end points at y3 = 0 and 1.0 which are binary salt solutions at I = 1.5 m (KCl 1.5 m, NaCl 1.5 m, K2SO4 0.5 m, Na2SO4 0.5 m). Values for the same pure solution recur across blocks and differ slightly (e.g. NaCl 57.831, 57.820, 57.428).
